body_mass.definition: Measured mass of the same person; weight is used colloquially by the source, not gravitational force.
body_mass.context: Same human, measured body mass and standing height at the same assessment. Source scope: ages 2 years and older, with adult use from age 20; arithmetic index only. Age-specific percentiles and clinical interpretation are outside this record.

body_mass.definition: Actual measured total body mass of this patient, used only when that is the independently authorized prescription basis.
body_mass.context: Same patient, drug/active-moiety mass basis, independently authorized prescription and one administration. Application profile: actual measured body mass is the independently authorized basis. The prescribed coefficient is per kilogram per administration, not per day or per time. Source examples are pediatric; the arithmetic has no drug-specific clinical validation population.

body_mass.definition: Actual measured patient body mass; no ideal/adjusted mass substitution in this profile.
body_mass.context: Historical adult Cockcroft–Gault creatinine-clearance estimate for the same patient's age, actual measured mass and serum creatinine. Age profile 18–92 years, stable renal function, non-obese/non-malnourished body composition; no pregnancy-specific validation. Original derivation was in men; the female adjustment is a source-stated estimate without equivalent validation. Assay provenance must be supplied outside the scalar record.

body_mass.definition: Actual measured human body mass for the same assessment as linear body extent.
body_mass.context: Same human body-mass and stature/recumbent-length assessment. The source glossary defines the human mass/height-cubed index and explicitly allows infant length. Use standing height for a standing-stature instance or recumbent crown-to-heel length for an infant instance; record the method and do not silently substitute one for another. This is an arithmetic index, not validated adiposity or nutrition classification.

body_mass.definition: Actual body mass at the identified postpartum assessment following the specified childbirth event.
body_mass.context: Same person following a childbirth event, body mass at a specified postpartum assessment and an explicitly identified pre-pregnancy or early-pregnancy baseline. Both are actual measured body masses on comparable measurement bases. Source glossary is in a maternal nutrition report; the difference is definitional, not a calibrated clinical risk or treatment model.

body_mass.definition: Actual measured body mass at the declared pre-pregnancy or early-pregnancy baseline for the same pregnancy.

body_mass.definition: Actual measured usual/baseline body mass at the declared reference assessment.

body_mass.definition: Actual measured body mass at the initial assessment.
body_mass.context: Same person, two actual body-mass assessments on comparable measurement bases, and the positive continuous elapsed interval between them. Source human assessment includes adults and children; this endpoint mean is not a fitted growth curve or age-specific normal rate. Direction is later mass minus earlier mass; time is supplied in seconds, not visit count or a calendar-year default.

body_mass.definition: Actual measured body mass at the later assessment.

standing_body_height.definition: Measured standing height of the same person at the same assessment.

body_mass_index.definition: Body mass divided by squared standing height; not a body-fat fraction or BMI-for-age percentile.
body_mass_index.context: Same human, measured body mass and standing height at the same assessment. Source scope: ages 2 years and older, with adult use from age 20; arithmetic index only. Age-specific percentiles and clinical interpretation are outside this record.

deferred_coverage.title: Cockcroft-Gault clearance and source-image inspection
deferred_coverage.reason: Continue in b02. PubMed original abstract directly inspected (249 derivation patients aged 18–92, 236 comparisons, r=0.83); original PDF opened but has no extracted text and screenshot calls returned no inspectable image. Shell PDF download blocked by network sandbox. An official eviQ HTML equation and scope were inspected; finish source normalization and resolve symbol/unit ambiguity before completing a record.

deferred_coverage.title: Infusion duration as a separate record
deferred_coverage.reason: Equivalent inverse of clinical-arithmetic--mean-volumetric-infusion-rate; source Sample Exercise 16.4 is documented in inverse_notes. Do not mint a duplicate.

deferred_coverage.title: OpenStax gravity-infusion wording and licensing
deferred_coverage.reason: Not used as the equation authority: section labels the drop factor with a rate unit. Main example is dimensionally coherent but independent BCcampus derivation was preferred. OpenStax live page states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 plus AI-use restrictions; no clearance for downstream AI/commercial use is inferred. Keep this source-discovery/rights uncertainty visible; no full source text is redistributed.

deferred_coverage.title: All renal-clearance inverse views
deferred_coverage.reason: Assignment boundary explicitly requires clearance inversions to be deferred. Forward Cockcroft–Gault and timed-urine definitions are retained in b02; inverse views are not offered or numerically tested. Future owner-authorized scope would need target-specific denominator, domain, statistical-identifiability and population checks; root or approximate inversion must never be substituted.

deferred_coverage.title: Equal subdivision of daily total across administrations
